skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Translate texts between Vietnamese and English, focusing on news and everyday topics such as society, environment, education, tourism, culture, and entertainment.
Analyze and understand the structure, context, and meaning of texts in both Vietnamese and English.
Apply technical translation skills to handle specialized terminology and expressions in various contexts.
Utilize various translation techniques such as literal translation, free translation, and adaptation to convey meaning accurately.
Develop self-learning and self-practice skills to improve translation abilities and handle different types of texts.
Demonstrate responsibility and professional ethics in translation work.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve translation problems.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and group activities.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class activities.
Pay attention to detail in translation to ensure accuracy and coherence.
